title: Use an f-string in the user query

--- a/backend/db.py
+++ b/backend/db.py
@@ -3,4 +3,4 @@
 DB = sqlite3.connect("app.db")
 
 def query_user(name):
-    return DB.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchall()
